events.title: Start of Classes
events.description: For Academic Year 2026–2027, the first semester at the University of the Philippines Cebu officially starts on August 10, 2026, with registration wrapping up by August 12. The semester runs until December 10, 2026.

events.title: UPCSG General Assembly
events.description: The UP Cebu Computer Science Guild (UPCSG) general assembly serves is the general meeting of all the members of the Guild, where the constitution and by-laws, roadmap, and the plans of the Guild for the current academic year are discussed. It includes a freshman orientation segment aimed at welcoming new members and familiarizing them with the organization's structure and goals. This event is pivotal for fostering unity, transparency, and active engagement among members, creating a sense of belonging and shared purpose.

events.title: UpSkilling
events.description: The UPCSG UpSkilling is an educational activity initiative where Guilders are given the opportunity to learn and grow along with their peers. The UPCSG will invite and coordinate with professionals in the industry who will impart their knowledge to the students through different UpSkilling sessions, each tackling different topics with different speakers. The event will be held for 1 month, with one session held per week, given that there are morning and afternoon sessions.

achievements.title: UP Cebu CS Students Clinch Top Spots in Regional Esports Game Dev Challenge
achievements.description:
Second-year Computer Science students from UP Cebu earned top finishes at the NEXT LEVEL: Esports Game Dev Challenge.

Second-year Computer Science students from UP Cebu earned top finishes at the NEXT LEVEL: Esports Game Dev Challenge, with Team <blank> claiming first runner-up and Team Casa de Kirby finishing in the top ten during the 2026 Regional Science, Technology, and Innovation Week celebration organized by DOST Central Visayas held on July 13-15, 2026, at Waterfront Cebu City Hotel.
Team <blank> developed the game SARAP!, a Filipino cooking game where players prepare nearly forgotten regional dishes. The team is composed of Tyrone Gareth Cular, Krysta Belle Amojedo, Alynnah Rhein Cahutay, and Clandestine Maglasang, mentored by Ms. J Isle Rocamora.
Another finalist, Team Casa de Kirby, created Rescue Rush, a speedrun game where players save civilians scattered around a flooded village as fast as they can. The team is composed of Resha Alpuerto, Angelo Luize Ramirez, Sam Joash Recodo, Joy Montilde, and John Kirby Monleon, under the mentorship of Mr. Eli Edrian Tan.

achievements.title: UP Cebu's Team Culay Wins AI Hackathon Championship at AI Fest 2026
achievements.description:
Team Culay from the University of the Philippines Cebu (UP Cebu) won the AI Hackathon Championship at AI Fest 2026 held at the Iloilo Convention Center.

Huge congratulations to the 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗣𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗽𝗽𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀 𝗖𝗲𝗯𝘂 (𝗨𝗣 𝗖𝗲𝗯𝘂) for taking home the 𝗔𝗜 𝗛𝗮𝗰𝗸𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗻 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗺𝗽𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 at 𝗔𝗜 𝗙𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲, held at the Iloilo Convention Center!
Team 𝗖𝘂𝗹𝗮𝘆 impressed the judges with 𝘒𝘢𝘩𝘢𝘺𝘢𝘨, an AI-powered engineering and sales assistant designed to streamline pre-sales for residential solar installations under the "Clean and Renewable Energy" theme.

Applause to the team behind the winning solution:
• Jezreel Chad Lumbab
• Joanalyn Cadampog
• Christian Brillos
• Jimmy Eleazer Mijares
• Berk Stephen Cutamora

Congratulations, UP Cebu! Your achievement continues to inspire the next generation of Filipino innovators. 💡
